result.rationale: The athlete reports sharp calf pain, stopped Tuesday's tempo at 6 km with RPE 9, and has a history of achilles tightness. This is a clear injury signal, so the rest of week 2 is reduced to protect the lower leg. Thursday and Saturday become rest days, and Sunday's long run becomes a short, optional recovery run that is only done if walking and daily movement are pain-free. Weeks 3 onward are unchanged; if pain persists, the athlete should see a physio before resuming.

changes.summary: Removed the 10 km easy run and made Thursday a rest day because of sharp calf pain, to allow healing.
Removed the 9 km easy run and made Saturday a rest day because of sharp calf pain; use the time for walking, mobility and gentle self-care.
Replaced the 17 km long run with an optional 5 km recovery run, done only if pain-free, because the calf needs rest and long mileage is a risk.

weeks.focus: Calf pain: rest, then a cautious test run

sessions.title: Optional recovery 5 km
sessions.description: Only run if walking and daily movement are completely pain-free. Keep it flat, very easy and stop at the first sign of calf pain. If it hurts, skip it and rest.
